infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PawCut needs camera access to capture stray cats and beloved pets to transform them into stickers.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PawCut saves and imports your pet photos to generate sticker cutouts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: PawCut saves high-quality pet stickers to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PawCut notes the neighborhood location of spotted stray animals on your sticker map.

plugins.cameraPermission: PawCut needs camera access to capture stray cats and pets.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: PawCut records animal sighting spots on your interactive pet map.

plugins.photosPermission: PawCut accesses photos to import and save stickers.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: PawCut saves custom animal stickers to your gallery.

plugins.photosPermission: PawCut accesses your photo library to pick pet photos for sticker cutting.
